name: Ground-Based Plasma-S
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 11. One of the ground base fits — the chassis is the
GBD1's and is identical across all of them: one shield of 12 (P2.73), two hull boxes, a bridge,
sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0, five crew, two boarding parties, minCrew 2, DK:4, EX:0,
CR:0. Only the weapons, the power plant, the BPV and the year differ.
The plasma fires into FP, the forward plasma arc, where the phasers use FH; the sheet
draws the two separately. Our ArcUtils defines FP as equal to FH, so they coincide
today — the distinction is kept because the sheet keeps it.
NOT MODELLED: the Sabot refit (Y180, +1), which allows speed-40 torpedoes per FP11.0 in
Module R10 — a module we do not have. Nor the middle-years version: between Y120 and
